examples.title: Actions
examples.description: Use a labelled trigger and real onSelect callbacks. Arrows move between actions, typing finds a label, and keyboard Escape returns focus.

examples.title: Checkboxes and radio groups
examples.description: Control independent toggles with checked and one choice with value. Prevent default onSelect to keep the menu open after each change.

examples.title: Nested actions
examples.description: Use Sub, SubTrigger and SubContent for secondary actions. Right Arrow opens the submenu; Left Arrow returns. Portal keeps the nested menu outside the scrolling parent.

examples.title: Descriptions, shortcuts and disabled items
examples.description: Descriptions wrap within the available width. suffix and Shortcut add supporting content. Shortcut text is a hint; your app owns the actual shortcut handler. Disabled items are skipped.

examples.title: Compose a native link
examples.description: asChild preserves a single anchor, its href, callbacks and ref, including descriptions. Change only the import path when migrating existing v1 compositions.

examples.title: Controlled and non-modal
examples.description: modal stays true by default. Opt into modal={false} when outside controls should respond on the first click; open and onOpenChange remain controlled.

examples.title: Long menus and narrow viewports
examples.description: Content and SubContent use Radix available dimensions, cap at 20rem and scroll inside the popup. Keyboard navigation brings the active row into view.

examples.title: Inside a dialog
examples.description: The menu remains the top dismissible layer. First Escape closes the menu and restores its trigger; the next closes the dialog.
